# Nextcloud Production - Simplified

## Quick Start

1. Replace SSH key in `nextcloud-production.yaml`
2. Convert: `butane --pretty --strict nextcloud-production.yaml > prod.ign`
3. Deploy to server with Ignition file
## Environment

Edit `/opt/nextcloud/.env`:
```bash
DOMAIN=nextcloud.yourdomain.com
ACME_EMAIL=admin@yourdomain.com
NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_USER=admin
# Passwords generated by generate-secrets.sh
```

## Deployment

```bash
# Deploy
sudo /opt/bin/deploy-production.sh

# Check status
cd /opt/nextcloud && docker-compose ps

# View logs
docker-compose logs -f
```

## Management

```bash
# OCC commands
sudo /opt/bin/nextcloud-occ.sh status

# Update system  
sudo /opt/bin/update-system.sh

# Backup
sudo /opt/bin/backup-nextcloud.sh
```

## Access

- **Nextcloud**: https://yourdomain.com
- **Collabora**: https://collabora.yourdomain.com
- **Traefik Dashboard**: https://traefik.yourdomain.com
